revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, local-only, later converted into a transparent 768x768 PNG
Asset name: achievement_medal_postcards_tier_004
Primary request: Create one premium collectible postcard achievement medal for tier 4, PURPLE rank. Based on the Chinese title concept "有钱人也不全是无情无义之人". The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for background removal; one uniform color only, no shadows or gradients.
Subject: exactly one centered circular medal. Inside is a unified funny anthropomorphic postcard/envelope mascot, definitely a rectangular ivory postcard body with rounded corners and envelope fold lines, tiny cartoon arms and legs, expressive face. Tier 4 gag: the postcard is dramatically trying to prove it has a heart, holding a tiny glossy heart-shaped scale or heart badge like courtroom evidence, with a serious overacting face.
Medal border: PURPLE rank, fourth visual level: violet and amethyst enamel circular ring with silver trim, ornate top gem, refined side ornaments, slightly more dramatic than blue, but no huge wings yet.
Style/medium: polished 3D-like mobile game collectible, glossy enamel and metal, cute humorous center mascot, crisp small-UI readability, same family as travel and foot medals.
Composition/framing: one centered medal only, full object visible, generous padding, central postcard mascot inside circular core.
Lighting/mood: bright glossy highlights, mock-serious comedy.
Color palette: violet and amethyst purple border, silver trim, ivory postcard mascot, tiny red heart prop. Avoid #00ff00 anywhere in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no foot, no toes, no shoe, no sock, no animal, no human, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no address lines, no stamp marks, no postmark rings, no watermark, no suitcase, no money pile, no cast shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
